citation: Parvaresh Rizi E, Loh TP, Baig S, et al. A high carbohydrate, but not fat or protein meal attenuates postprandial ghrelin, PYY and GLP-1 responses in Chinese men. PLoS ONE. 2018.
protocol: Cross-over liquid meals, ~600 kcal and ~400 mL, high-protein, high-fat or high-carbohydrate, taken after 10 h overnight fast; 6 h sampling
population: n=9 lean insulin-sensitive (HOMA-IR 0.83) + n=9 obese insulin-resistant (HOMA-IR 4.34) normoglycaemic Chinese men aged 21-40 y
note: Macronutrient contrast (carbohydrate/fat/protein) in lean vs obese men. Tables are iAUC and percent change; time courses are figures. Obese arm non-healthy.
